opsproc.title: SATCOM Data Mode (procedures require SATCOM datalink)

item.para: ATC datalink applications (ADS-C, CPDLC, DCL, OCL, and D-ATIS) over ACARS are not available.
Associated ATC datalink Required Communication / Surveillance Performance (RCP 240 and above for CPDLC and RSP 180 and above for ADS-C) capabilities are lost.
As an alternate procedure, ATC may permit the use of SATCOM or HF voice communication on alternate route that does not require FANS A aircraft capability.
